manual: Build with community-apps/checkmate/install.sh (CMake + Qt Quick 3D). Stock Devuan Excalibur Qt 6.8 is enough.
Needs OpenGL at runtime (GPU driver, or libgl1-mesa-dri / mesa-libgallium for software GL). Uses XCB via qt6-qpa-plugins (no qt6-wayland).
Hyprland corner rounding is skipped when HYPRLAND_INSTANCE_SIGNATURE is unset, so corners stay square on i3.
Theme and language follow Omarchy paths under ~/.local/state/omarchy/current/.
Tests (bin/test) need xvfb-run, xauth, and fonts-dejavu-core; the app builds without them.
